feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle forage for their own feed all through the year, and when selling time comes they are finished on irrigated pasture.

pickup_locations: Phoenix: lot across from Ben Avery shooting range off Carefree Hwy
Prescott Valley: Maverick Station, Fain Rd and AZ-69
Camp Verde: Chevron and Wendy's lot off Hwy 260

address: 5 Date Creek Ranch Rd, Wickenburg, AZ 85358
notes: Beef page says cattle live on native forages, irrigated pasture and occasionally some hay. Lamb sold as 100% grass-fed, offered as the ranch has its own lambs available. Pigs are raised outdoors on rotated paddocks but most of their diet is non-GMO grain and corn, so pork is pastured, not grass-fed. Beef orders need a $299 deposit. Pickup only at scheduled meat-up points (no shipping stated); sales_channels farm-pickup used for these. No drop-ins at the ranch. Second phone (602) 527-9369. Shop is on Shopify (datecreekranch.shop).

availability.note: Beef and lamb are sold through a waitlist; beef waits can run 10 to 12 weeks.
